headlines: Red Cat Q3 loss widens to $40.4M; 2026 target withdrawn (StockTitan, 8-K material event, 2026-11-16)
Red Cat withdraws 2026 revenue target, reports Q3 results (Investing.com, 2026-11-16)
Red Cat withdraws 2026 revenue target as Q3 loss widens to $40.4M (Dealroom, 2026-11-17)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Red Cat reported fiscal Q3 2026 after the Nov 16 close. Revenue came in at $11.8M, +22% YoY, but gross profit collapsed to roughly $65,000 from $638,000 a year earlier - an effectively zero (~0.6%) gross margin - while net loss widened to $40.448M from $16.017M. Management withdrew the full-year 2026 revenue target outright, citing funding and contract awards progressing more slowly than expected plus the loss of an anticipated revenue contribution following Gauntlet II. Nine-month revenue is still +227% YoY at $47.4M, so the break is this quarter and the forward guide rather than the year-to-date trajectory. Re-confirmed this run against StockTitan's 8-K page, Investing.com and Dealroom; no Yahoo-sourced figures.
gappers.why: The guidance withdrawal combined with the near-zero gross margin is the mechanism, not the revenue line itself. Pulling a full-year target with one quarter left removes the revenue ramp the equity was priced on, and $65k of gross profit on $11.8M of revenue says the units that shipped carried no contribution - so the de-rating hits the growth multiple and the credibility of operating leverage simultaneously. Gauntlet II deletes the named near-term program catalyst. Forced-seller mechanics compound it: the stock slid steadily into the print ($4.28 Nov 11 -> $3.525 Nov 16), and breaking the $3 handle drops it out of many funds' and screeners' eligible universes.
gappers.impact: Structural, not a one-day headline spike, and still deteriorating rather than mean-reverting. The move has deepened monotonically across all three of today's runs: -30.03% at 07:12 ET -> -32.71% at 08:08 ET -> -33.95% at 09:09 ET, with no dead-cat bid in two hours. A withdrawn full-year guide plus a zero gross margin has no same-day repair path. The balance sheet is thinner than the headline cash suggests: $242.7M cash against $156.8M of nine-month operating burn is roughly 14 months of runway at the current rate, before the proposed all-cash Steyr Motors offer (EUR 39.00/share, acceptance period ends Dec 18 2026) consumes more - so a raise/dilution is a live risk, not a remote one. Sector read-through remains largely idiosyncratic: drone/defense peers are mixed and small (DPRO +1.49%, AVAV -1.03%), i.e. no peer is being repriced on this.
gappers.horizon_reasoning: The reset is structural but structurally BEARISH; for a long-biased book the only expression is a days-long oversold bounce, and the name sits far below its 200-SMA, so there is no multi-week long thesis until a contract award or the Steyr close carries a firm date and number.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Book is 100% cash ($100,000 equity, 0 positions, 0 open orders), so nothing would be displaced and all 3/3 weekly trade slots are open - the binding constraint is the rulebook, not capacity. RCAT fails on four independent counts: (1) at $2.3316 it is below this routine's own $3.00 price floor, having gapped THROUGH it from a $3.53 close; (2) it is far under its 200-SMA, so the long-bias filter blocks any long outright; (3) there is no documented bullish catalyst - guidance was withdrawn - so it fails the Confluence rule (>=2 indicators + 1 catalyst), and bottom-fishing on drawdown alone is explicitly forbidden; (4) R:R cannot clear the 2:1 minimum at a sane stop - ATR(14) of about $0.385 is ~10.9% of the Nov 16 close and ~16.5% of the current price, so a 10% stop near $2.10 is only ~0.6 ATR, inside a single day's range and near-certain to be hit before any thesis resolves, while a 2:1 target would demand a near-full round trip to yesterday's close within days. The real cost of taking it would be burning one of three weekly slots and up to 20% of equity on a falling knife while trend-aligned names (NIO +4.0%, CMBT +2.7%, NBIS +2.0%) go untouched. Research only - no order placed (STEP 8).
